title: Ask to be kept by the Will
summary: Peace begins when the self asks to be kept by Hukam. Return to Hukam before the self starts arguing again.
takeaway: Return to Hukam before the self starts arguing again.
lifeApplication: Before arguing with the moment again, stop, name what is already here, and let one resistance fall away.

source.shortMeaning: Peace begins when the self asks to be kept by Hukam.
source.lifeApplication: When pride hardens, ask to be held by the Will before you act.

evidence.coreClaim: Peace begins when the self asks to be kept by Hukam.
evidence.turn: Serve first, and let peace expose the self.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before arguing with the moment again, stop, name what is already here, and let one resistance fall away.
